have fn r54_deg(theta R) R = theta * pi / 180

have fn r54_secant(theta R: cos(theta) != 0) R = 1 / cos(theta)

have fn r54_cosine_law_third_side_sq(a, b, gamma R) R = a^2 + b^2 - 2 * a * b * cos(gamma)

cases.source:
have fn r54_deg(theta R) R = theta * pi / 180

have fn r54_secant(theta R: cos(theta) != 0) R = 1 / cos(theta)

have fn r54_cosine_law_third_side_sq(a, b, gamma R) R = a^2 + b^2 - 2 * a * b * cos(gamma)

forall x R:
    cos(x) != 0
    =>:
        tan(x) = sin(x) / cos(x)
        r54_secant(x) = 1 / cos(x)
        1 + tan(x)^2 = 1 / cos(x)^2
        1 / cos(x)^2 = (1 / cos(x))^2
        (1 / cos(x))^2 = r54_secant(x)^2
